item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 02/Nov/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream affecting the coast of Guangdong will strengthen gradually today. It will be windy and cloudier over the region in the next couple of days. An anticyclone aloft is expected to cover southern China midweek this week. The weather will improve slightly over the region, although slightly cooler in the morning. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Kalmaegi will intensify gradually, with a higher chance of moving across the Philippines and entering the central and southern parts of the South China Sea midweek this week, moving towards the vicinity of Vietnam. An area of low pressure will affect the central and southern parts of the South China Sea today.
